question: A cell is placed in a solution and water moves out of the cell by osmosis. What can be concluded about the solution surrounding the cell?
options: The solution has a lower solute concentration than the cell cytoplasm
The solution is isotonic to the cell
The solution has a higher solute concentration than the cell cytoplasm
The solution has a higher water potential than the cell cytoplasm

question: Which of the following correctly describes the process of transcription in eukaryotic cells?
options: DNA is translated into protein in the cytoplasm
mRNA is synthesised from a DNA template in the nucleus using RNA polymerase
tRNA carries amino acids to the ribosome during protein synthesis
DNA is replicated semi-conservatively before cell division

question: A metal displaces hydrogen from dilute hydrochloric acid. Which property of the metal allows it to do this?
options: It is less reactive than hydrogen
It is more reactive than hydrogen
It has a higher atomic mass than hydrogen
It has more electrons than hydrogen

question: In a food chain, energy is lost between trophic levels. Which process accounts for the GREATEST loss of energy from one trophic level to the next?
options: Excretion of waste materials
Energy used in reproduction
Energy lost as heat through cellular respiration
Reflection of light from organisms

question: Which of the following best explains why noble gases are unreactive?
options: They have very low boiling points
They exist as monatomic gases at room temperature
They have a complete outermost electron shell
They have the highest ionisation energies of all elements

question: A wave travels from air into glass and its speed decreases. Which statement correctly describes what happens to its frequency and wavelength?
options: Frequency increases and wavelength decreases
Frequency stays the same and wavelength decreases
Frequency decreases and wavelength stays the same
Both frequency and wavelength decrease

question: During meiosis, genetic variation is increased by which TWO processes?
options: DNA replication and cytokinesis
Crossing over and independent assortment of chromosomes
Mitosis and independent assortment
Crossing over and semi-conservative replication

question: A student titrates 25.0 cm³ of NaOH solution with 0.1 mol/dm³ HCl solution. The titre is 20.0 cm³. What is the concentration of the NaOH solution?
options: 0.08 mol/dm³
0.125 mol/dm³
0.1 mol/dm³
0.05 mol/dm³

question: Which of the following is a correct statement about enzymes?
options: Enzymes are consumed during the reactions they catalyse
Enzymes lower the activation energy of a reaction
Enzymes increase the activation energy to speed up reactions
Enzymes change the overall energy released in a reaction

question: A circuit contains a resistor of 10 Ω connected to a 20 V battery. What is the power dissipated by the resistor?
options: 2 W

question: Which statement correctly explains why the melting point of sodium chloride is much higher than that of iodine?
options: Sodium chloride has stronger covalent bonds than iodine
Sodium chloride has an ionic lattice requiring large amounts of energy to break, while iodine has weak van der Waals forces between molecules
Iodine has a larger molecular mass than sodium chloride
Sodium chloride molecules have stronger dipole-dipole interactions than iodine

question: A population of bacteria doubles every 20 minutes. Starting with 100 bacteria, how many will be present after 1 hour?
Which of the following statements about the carbon cycle is correct?
options: Combustion removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere
Photosynthesis releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
Decomposition by microorganisms returns carbon to the atmosphere as carbon dioxide
Respiration fixes carbon dioxide into organic compounds

question: An object of mass 5 kg is lifted to a height of 4 m above the ground. What is its gravitational potential energy? (g = 10 m/s²)
options: 9 J
2 J

question: Which of the following correctly identifies the role of the left ventricle in the human circulatory system?
options: It receives oxygenated blood from the body and pumps it to the lungs
It receives deoxygenated blood from the body and pumps it to the lungs
It receives oxygenated blood from the lungs and pumps it to the body at high pressure
It receives deoxygenated blood from the lungs and pumps it to the body
